description:
About Bask Health
 Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
 Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
 We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
 Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
 About the Role
 We're looking for a Product Engineer, New Grad to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build the software that powers our telehealth platform.
 This role is designed for recent graduates and early-career engineers who enjoy building applications, solving problems, and learning how real products are developed and maintained.
 You'll contribute to features across our platform, including merchant tools, patient experiences, and internal applications. Depending on the project, your work may involve frontend development, backend functionality, APIs, or integrations.
 You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn ideas into working software. You'll receive technical guidance and feedback while gradually taking on greater ownership of your work.
 We're looking for someone who is curious, proactive, comfortable learning new technologies, and excited to build products that people use.
 What You'll Do
 Build and improve product features across Bask's web applications.
 Develop user-facing interfaces using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
 Contribute to frontend applications built with Next.js.
 Help implement backend functionality using Node.js and TypeScript.
 Work with APIs to connect frontend applications and backend services.
 Assist with developing and maintaining reusable UI components.
 Contribute to merchant-facing and patient-facing product experiences.
 Help improve application usability, responsiveness, and performance.
 Work with SQL databases and learn how application data is organized.
 Implement smaller features and improvements with guidance from experienced engineers.
 Collaborate with product managers and designers to understand feature requirements.
 Translate technical specifications into working application functionality.
 Write clean, readable, and maintainable code.
 Learn and apply automated testing practices.
 Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback.
 Investigate bugs and help troubleshoot application issues.
 Assist with integrating existing APIs and third-party services.
 Learn Bask's application architecture and development workflows.
 Contribute to documentation and technical improvements.
 Participate in engineering discussions and team planning.
 Use Git and collaborative development tools.
 Learn about application security, privacy, and reliability.
 Use AI-assisted development tools while checking and understanding generated code.
 Take increasing ownership of features as your technical skills develop.
 Requirements 
 
 Recent graduate or early-career engineer with a background in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Foundational understanding of software development and programming concepts.
 Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript.
 Experience building web applications through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional work.
 Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and modern frontend development.
 Familiarity with React or another component-based frontend framework.
 Understanding of how frontend applications communicate with backend services.
 Basic familiarity with APIs and HTTP requests.
 Foundational knowledge of databases and data structures.
 Understanding of common programming concepts, including functions, objects, and asynchronous operations.
 Familiarity with Git or another version control system.
 Ability to debug code and approach technical problems systematically.
 Willingness to learn new frameworks, libraries, and development tools.
 Ability to read documentation and apply technical guidance.
 Interest in building user-facing software products.
 Strong attention to detail and willingness to improve code quality.
 Ability to communicate questions, progress, and challenges clearly.
 Openness to feedback, mentorship, and collaborative development.
 Ability to work independently on clearly defined tasks.
 Interest in developing professionally within a remote engineering team.
 Nice to Have
 Internship or previous software development experience.
 Personal or academic projects using React or Next.js.
 Experience with Node.js or backend JavaScript development.
 Familiarity with TypeScript.
 Experience using SQL databases.
 Experience building or consuming REST APIs.
 Familiarity with automated testing frameworks.
 Experience deploying personal projects or web applications.
 Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms.
 Familiarity with serverless applications.
 Experience using Prisma, Drizzle ORM, or similar database tools.
 Experience contributing to open-source projects.
 Familiarity with UI component libraries or design systems.
 Interest in SaaS platforms, e-commerce, or merchant tools.
 Interest in healthcare or telehealth technology.
 Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
 A GitHub portfolio or project examples demonstrating technical curiosity and initiative.
